title: Blues and the cornetist Lewis Madison
summary: Blues were plentiful; Lewis Madison, a sweet blues and ragtime cornetist, joined after the split.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Chris Kelly, the blues trumpeter and his band

blocks.x: Did you play many blues when you were in the church?
Yes, blues, plenty. All kind of blues. We had all of the blues. Did you usually just make up the blues or did you play? We did. We had a corner player I didn't mention, Lewis Madison Schatz.
He came in after the Sillis and I split. Well he was a very good blues player. He made a hit on most anything he played. He was good at ragtime. Very sweet. Not too noisy. But he was good.
